scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @ofcpoker/client
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ofcpoker/game-engine && npm run build --workspace @ofcpoker/data-provider && npm run build --workspace @ofcpoker/ai-player
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ofcpoker/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.ts tests && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:packages && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
